decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mention to a dedicated page and, as a close fit with the firm's enterprise-integrated GeoIT focus, it likely meets aspiration levels well enough that management sees little reason to reallocate resources.

Although it remained only a mentioned offer rather than gaining stronger prominence, the framework is close to the core business and can support consulting and implementation work, so with some organisational slack management would more likely retain it than drop it.

The move to a dedicated page and the more specific positioning around integration with existing user-management systems suggest satisfactory market acceptance relative to aspirations, making continued support the likely choice.

As a newly launched workshop tightly linked to the firm's established consulting business, it is inexpensive to carry, strategically coherent, and likely to be given more time before any problemistic search would lead to withdrawal.
